label: clearKeepsPlace: keepPlace skipped on clear
find: keepingPlace: { node, placed in target.keepPlace(&node, world: placed) })
replace: keepingPlace: { node, placed in if p.parent != nil { target.keepPlace(&node, world: placed) } })

label: refusesCycle: the cycle refusal is not a sentence
find: case .cycle: "Layer \(p.parent ?? p.id) already follows \(p.id), so \(p.id) can't follow it."

label: set-anchor ignores keepPlace false
find: try target.setPlacement(p.keepPlace ?? true ? placement.movingAnchor(to: point) : loose, of: p.id)
